pages.text: A list of primitive but useful storage containers with their own unique purposes.$(br2)Sneaking while looking at an item inside a storage container shows how many of that item are available.$(br2)Using the scroll wheel while sneaking either adds or removes items.
Stores up to 9 different item types.
Same as a crate, but can be placed against walls.
Holds multiple stacks of one item or block type.
Stores up to 9 different types of logs.

A basket can be placed in-world, or picked up with its contents.$(br)However, when picked up, it can only be placed inside the hotbar.$(br2)The bigger the basket, the more items and larger stacks it can hold.
pages.title: Baskets
